title: A single higher-direct-image exchange passes to an affine inverse limit
statement: Let k be a field, D:I -> Over(Spec k) a small cofiltered diagram with qcqs structure maps and affine transitions, and c a cone whose underlying scheme cone is limiting and whose structure map is qcqs. Let f:X -> Spec k be qcqs, F any abelian etale sheaf, and q a natural number. If every degree-q homology map of the canonical bounded-below derived exchange for f and D_i at F[0] is invertible, then its degree-q homology map for f and c.pt.hom at F[0] is invertible. There is no smoothness, torsion, injectivity or algebraic closure hypothesis [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves].

proof.text: Construct the canonical cartesian derived-image objects, legs and transitions. Pasting gives e_i followed by leg_i equal to the limit exchange, where e_i is the pulled-back stage exchange with inverse-image composition transport. Exact inverse image preserves the degree-q stage isomorphisms, so every e_i is invertible. Pasting between stages and cancellation make every transition invertible; the limit legs are not assumed invertible.

At a geometric point of the limit base, use germ descent to represent every limit fiber element by a stage element. If a stage element maps to zero, use eventual germ vanishing and invertibility of the transition map to show the stage element itself is zero. Thus every point map of the limit exchange is bijective.
The sheaf-fiber detector turns pointwise bijectivity into an isomorphism of the degree-q homology map.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 59.86.3, second assertion, using Lemma 59.51.8 (Tag 0EYM); geometric germs isolated as support nodes by S4

theorem isIso_limit_homology_derivedBaseChangeMapPlus
    {k : Type u} [Field k]
    {I : Type u} [SmallCategory I] [IsCofiltered I]
    (D : I ⥤ Over (Spec (.of k)))
    [∀ i, QuasiCompact (D.obj i).hom] [∀ i, QuasiSeparated (D.obj i).hom]
    [∀ {i j : I} (a : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map a).left]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit ((Over.forget _).mapCone c))
    [QuasiCompact c.pt.hom] [QuasiSeparated c.pt.hom]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (q : ℕ)
    (hstage : ∀ i, IsIso
      ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ (q : ℤ)).map
        ((derivedBaseChangeMapPlus AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          (IsPullback.of_hasPullback f (D.obj i).hom).toCommSq).app
            ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F)))) :
    IsIso ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ (q : ℤ)).map
      ((derivedBaseChangeMapPlus AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (IsPullback.of_hasPullback f c.pt.hom).toCommSq).app
          ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F)))
